public.text: The Supplier Registry is classified as health-specific infrastructure, although suppliers may serve multiple government sectors and may already exist in national business, tax, procurement, or legal-entity registries.
public.suggestedRevision: Treat the Supplier Registry as a health-sector extension or view of foundational business and procurement registries where available. Define the health-specific attributes that justify a DPI-H capability.
